name: station_ack_response
description: Record station personnel's acknowledgment of a dispatch notification. Called after reading incident details to the station contact and asking for verbal acknowledgment.

emergency_id.description: Emergency ID for the dispatch being acknowledged

station_name.description: Name of the station being called

dispatch_record_id.description: System-provided dispatch record ID (from {{user_data.dispatch_record_id}}). Read it from your dispatch details verbatim — never invent or guess it.

call_id.description: System-provided call/execution ID (from {{user_data.call_id}}). Read it verbatim — never invent or guess it.

ack_status.description: Station personnel's response: 'acknowledged' if they accept the dispatch, 'rejected' if they cannot respond, 'needs_clarification' if they need more details

notes.description: Any additional notes or comments from the station personnel
